summary: A two location Abu Dhabi clinic appears to lose patients to wrong links, mixed branding and no opening hours.

findings.problem: The Google Reviews link appears to open a search for a different business name, and the footer WhatsApp message appears to name another clinic.
findings.cost: Patients may land on the wrong business and doubt who you are.
findings.fix: Links and messages that use your own clinic name.

findings.problem: The Book Now link appears to be a popup anchor, the hero and About sections appear twice, and no opening hours appear.
findings.cost: Patients cannot easily book or confirm when you are open.
findings.fix: One clear booking button and visible hours.

findings.problem: Typos such as Costmetic Dentistry, Hyfra Facial and qaFounded in 2016 appear, and the clinic name appears in five different forms.
findings.cost: Typos and mixed names weaken trust in a medical brand.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one brand name.

findings.problem: Five doctors appear to share one placeholder image, a reviewed doctor appears not to be listed, and the General Dentistry card appears to describe cosmetic dentistry.
findings.cost: Patients choose a dentist they can see, and mismatched cards confuse them.
findings.fix: Real doctor photos and correct service cards.
